decision: The upstream patch narrows the peer MDC table row-to-cell last-child selector. The owned Material-16 table markup and CSS have their historical `.mat-table` role. The exported `table-theme` is the retained M2 table-token emitter; it does not call `mat.table-overrides` and table is absent from the thirteen-family current-companion contract. Do not port this modern selector into the owned legacy table CSS. This does not claim current peer table CSS behavior as part of this package.
peer_coexistence_unresolved: No current table override bridge or supported current-peer table theme use is declared by the thirteen-family contract; do not infer a package-level peer-state test requirement from the retained token emitter.
